name: Ameriwest Lithium Inc.
summary: Ameriwest Lithium Inc., established in 2017 and based in Vancouver, Canada, is an enterprise focused on securing, exploring, and developing natural resource assets across both Canada and the United States. The company's primary exploration efforts target several promising lithium properties. In Nevada, these include the Deer Musk East property, encompassing 283 claims over 5,500 acres within the highly productive Clayton Valley; the Railroad Valley property, which comprises 462 claims spanning approximately 9,097 acres; and the Edwards Creek Valley property, featuring 1,243 adjoining claims that cover 22,200 acres. Additionally, Ameriwest holds the Thompson Valley property in Yavapai County, Arizona, an asset that totals 2,859 acres. Beyond these, its diverse resource holdings also feature the ESN project in White Pine County, Nevada; the Koster Dam property, situated in British Columbia's Clinton Mining Division; and the Quet and Fire property, also located in Canada. The company, originally incorporated as Oakley Ventures Inc., rebranded as Ameriwest Lithium Inc. in April 2021.
